Yeah there's multiple layers here all named "Blyg" — the underlying protocol up the Venkat's envisioned new style of blogging/tweeting — if you're using Blyg the protocol but basically just "blogging" still then you're a blogger and part of the blogosphere (to the degree that still exists). But if Blyging becomes a genuine new medium then it deserves its own name. Potentially though Blyg the protocol could birth other mediums just like RSS helped enable Podcasting.

What’s the best name for the community of blyg users?

by Kyle Mathews · quoted from v1

What should we call the network of blygs? Call for stub commentary towards a rough consensus, not a voting exercise.

Probably a minority take, but I think the best term for people who use Blygger is just: bloggers.

Blygger is a useful update to blogging. It extends blogging, but it’s not separate.

Update: Looks like I was quoting a quote. Original question here. Anyway, we’re still in the blogosphere, if you ask me. 

—Brady Dale
September 29, 2026
